en: The color of blood or a ripe tomato.
ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
她穿著紅色洋裝去參加派對。

en: A person who is part of your family; or compared with something else.
ex: All my relatives came to my birthday party.
我所有的親戚都來參加我的生日派對。

en: To keep information in your mind; or to bring something back to your mind.
ex: Do you remember where you put your keys?
你記得你把鑰匙放哪裡嗎？

en: To say or do something again; or something that happens again.
ex: Please repeat what you just said.
請重複你剛才說的話。

en: A spoken or written description of an event; or to tell the news; or a school record of grades.
ex: She wrote a report about her trip to Japan.
她寫了一份關於日本之旅的報告。

en: A person whose job is to gather news and write or speak about it for newspapers, TV or radio.
ex: The reporter asked the mayor several questions.
記者問了市長幾個問題。

en: A period of relaxing or sleeping; or to stop working or being active; or the remaining part of something.
ex: You look tired; you should take a rest.
你看起來很累，應該休息一下。

en: A place where you can buy and eat a meal.
ex: We had dinner at a nice restaurant downtown.
我們在市中心一家不錯的餐廳吃晚餐。

en: Small white or brown seeds from a plant that are cooked and eaten, especially in Asia.
ex: Rice is the main food in many Asian countries.
米飯是許多亞洲國家的主食。

en: Having a lot of money or valuable things; or containing a lot of something, such as food with a strong taste.
ex: The rich man gave a lot of money to the school.
那位富翁捐了很多錢給學校。

en: To sit on an animal or a bicycle and control it; or to travel in a vehicle; or a journey.
ex: I ride my bicycle to school every morning.
我每天早上騎腳踏車上學。

en: Correct or true; or on the side of your body opposite the left; or something you are allowed to do.
ex: Turn right at the corner and you will see the bank.
在轉角右轉，你就會看到銀行。

en: To make the sound of a bell; or to call someone by phone; or a circle of metal worn on a finger.
ex: The phone rang while I was in the shower.
我洗澡時電話響了。

en: To go up or become higher; or to stand up from a sitting position; or an increase.
ex: The sun rises in the east.
太陽從東方升起。

en: A large natural flow of water that runs across land into the sea.
ex: The river flows through the center of the city.
這條河流經市中心。

en: A hard surface made for vehicles and people to travel on between places.
ex: Be careful when you cross the road.
過馬路時要小心。

en: A machine that can do some tasks automatically, sometimes shaped like a person.
ex: The robot can clean the floor by itself.
這個機器人可以自己打掃地板。

en: The hard material that forms mountains; or a large piece of stone; or a type of loud music; or to move gently from side to side.
ex: He sat on a large rock beside the river.
他坐在河邊的一塊大岩石上。

en: To move by turning over and over; or to make something round; or a small, round bread.
ex: The ball rolled down the hill.
球從山坡上滾了下去。

en: A part of a building with walls and a door; or the amount of space available.
ex: Her room is on the second floor.
她的房間在二樓。

en: The part of a plant that grows under the ground; or the cause or beginning of something.
ex: The roots of the old tree went deep into the soil.
老樹的根深深伸入土壤。

en: A thick, strong cord made of twisted threads; or to tie something with a rope.
ex: The climbers tied a rope around the tree.
登山者把繩子綁在樹上。

en: A sweet-smelling flower with thorns on its stem; or the past tense of 'rise'.
ex: He gave his wife a bunch of red roses.
他送了妻子一束紅玫瑰。

en: Shaped like a circle or ball; or one section of a game or event.
ex: We sat around a round table for dinner.
我們圍著一張圓桌吃晚餐。

en: A line of people or things next to each other; or to move a boat using oars; or a noisy argument.
ex: We sat in the front row of the theater.
我們坐在劇院的第一排。

en: An official statement about what you can or cannot do; or to govern a country.
ex: The school has a rule against running in the halls.
學校規定禁止在走廊奔跑。

en: A flat stick for measuring length or drawing lines; or a person who governs a country.
ex: She used a ruler to draw a straight line.
她用尺畫了一條直線。

en: To move quickly on foot; or to manage a business; or to flow; or to operate.
ex: The boy ran home as fast as he could.
那個男孩儘快跑回家。

en: Feeling unhappy, especially because something bad has happened.
ex: She was sad when her best friend moved away.
她最要好的朋友搬走時，她很難過。

en: Not in danger of being harmed; or not likely to cause harm; or a strong box for keeping money.
ex: It is safe to cross the street when the light is green.
綠燈時過馬路是安全的。

en: A cold dish of raw vegetables, often with a dressing.
ex: I had a salad and a sandwich for lunch.
我午餐吃了一份沙拉和一個三明治。

en: The act of selling something; or a time when shops sell goods at lower prices.
ex: Everything in the shop is on sale this week.
這家店本週所有東西都在特價。

en: A white substance used to add flavor to food; or to put salt on food.
ex: Add a little salt to the soup.
在湯裡加一點鹽。

en: Exactly like another thing; or not different or changed.
ex: We go to the same school.
我們念同一所學校。

en: To keep someone or something safe from harm; or to keep money for the future; or to store data.
ex: She saves a little money every month.
她每個月存一點錢。

en: To express something using words; or to give your opinion; or to read something aloud.
ex: What did the teacher say about the homework?
老師對功課說了什麼？

en: A place where children go to learn; or a group of fish swimming together.
ex: I walk to school every morning.
我每天早上走路上學。

en: The study of the natural world through experiments; or a school subject such as physics and biology.
ex: I like science, especially biology.
我喜歡自然科學，特別是生物。

en: A very large area of salt water that covers much of the Earth.
ex: We spent our holiday by the sea.
我們在海邊度過了假期。

en: One of the four periods of the year: spring, summer, autumn and winter; or to add salt or spices to food.
ex: Summer is my favorite season.
夏天是我最喜歡的季節。
